issue.title: Bug: test_po_cleanup - stop rsyslogd in swss command causes failures in multi-asic devices

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

The test stops rsyslogd by performing `docker exec swss supervisorctl stop rsyslogd` added in #20327, which causes failures on multi-asic platforms

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the test on multi-asic platform

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Fails with `Error response from daemon: No such container: swss`, it should target swss with asic id appended to the end for multi-asic platforms, e.g. `swss0, swss1`

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Stop failures of pc/test_ro_cleanup.py on multi-asic platforms due to stop rsyslogd command added in #20327 not working for multi-asic devices
#### How did you do it?
Append asic id to stop rsyslogd command and loop for each asic id
#### How did you verify/test it?
Test on single-asic platform (T1): https://elastictest.org/scheduler/testplan/68e77bdbf92481107107cf05
